source_text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
child_paraphrase: Do not be afraid. God is with you, and He will help you and hold you up.
license_note: Short quotation of the 1769 Oxford King James Version. That edition is public domain in the United States. No bulk copyrighted Bible text is used.
lock_note: Issue #6 Mission 4 lock: Courage Over Fear.
forbidden_claims: Do not invent extra narrative as scripture
Do not treat woods, porches, lanterns, or other fall props as facts from this verse
Do not draw God as a cartoon character or add names and events that are not in Isaiah 41:10
